subject: Vendor registry & PO requirements — Glycon Health engagement
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@glyconhealth.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procure@glyconhealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration & PO requirements for upcoming engagement

Hi Tessa,

We’re getting ready to issue a purchase order for the pilot engagement and need Redwood onboarded in Glycon’s supplier registry before we can create the PO. Can you please: 

- Complete our vendor portal registration (link below).
- Return your AP onboarding packet and a sample invoice (PDF) with the exact fields you’ll use.
- Provide legal name, VAT/Tax IDs (if applicable), remit-to address, and bank wiring/ACH details.
- Attach a W-9 (or EU VAT certificate) depending on entity.

Important PO requirements:
- PO number must appear on the first page of the invoice and on the remittance line.
- We match on PO# + invoice amount + vendor tax id.
- Preferred invoice format: PDF, single attachment per invoice; we ingest into Coupa (PDF-to-XML conversion).
- Payment terms are Net30 by default; we can discuss early-pay opt-in during contracting.

Vendor portal (register here): https://vendor.glyconhealth.com/register/portal-ef8a2
Deadline for registration to meet our internal PO cut: 2027-05-10.

I’ve attached the portal instructions for convenience. Please let me know if you need any clarifications.

Thanks,
Samantha Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Glycon Health
procure@glyconhealth.com

Thanks Marcus and Tessa — that looks good. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Portal registration: we still need Redwood to register directly through the portal (our team cannot complete the registration on your behalf due to vendor attestations). Please use the same legal name as on the W-9/WHT docs.
- For EU invoices we require VAT registration number in the VAT field; if Redwood doesn’t have an EU VAT, indicate the US tax id and upload a VAT exemption statement.
- We can accept emailed PDF invoices for the pilot (please CC procure@glyconhealth.com) — our Coupa onboarding will accept single-PDF invoices for now.

Portal registration checklist (quick):
1) Company legal name (exact match to tax doc)
2) Primary remit email and payment terms
3) Bank details + attach voided AC with same account name
4) Tax docs: W-9 or EU VAT cert / or VAT exemption statement
5) Upload sample invoice (PDF)

Portal link: https://vendor.glyconhealth.com/register/portal-ef8a2
If you complete registration today we’ll provision the vendor ID and aim to issue the PO on 5/11.

Samantha
